#!/bin/bash
# Initialization script: prepares the working environment for the memory monitoring task.

echo "Initialization complete. Working directory: $WORKDIR"
EOF

#!/bin/bash
# Calculate the percentage of available memory that has been used, as an integer.
set -e

MEMINFO="/app/memory_monitor/meminfo.txt"

# Extract values (in KB) from the meminfo snapshot.
total=$(awk '/^MemTotal:/ {print $2}' "$MEMINFO")
free=$(awk '/^MemFree:/ {print $2}' "$MEMINFO")
avail=$(awk '/^MemAvailable:/ {print $2}' "$MEMINFO")

# Used memory = total - available (MemAvailable is the best estimate of usable memory).
used=$(( total - avail ))

# Percentage of used memory, rounded to the nearest integer.
percentage=$(( (used * 100 + total / 2) / total ))

echo "$percentage"
EOF
